name: City Blend
description: City Blend is a premium handmade brick defined by rich red base tones and darker firing marks that create a refined weathered appearance. Its textured finish and natural colour variation give each brick individual character, bringing warmth, depth and distinction to the finished build.

name: Heritage Blend
description: Heritage Blend is a premium handmade brick featuring a carefully balanced mix of reds, oranges and darker tones, finished with distinctive coal spotted detailing for an authentic traditional appearance. The handmade process creates a soft textured finish, while the natural variation in colour ensures every brick has its own individual character and charm.

name: Village Multi Handmade
description: Village Multi Handmade offers a gentle combination of warm reds, browns and muted tones, creating a soft and understated appearance. Its subtle variation and textured finish reflect the character of traditional rural buildings.

name: Barnstock Orange
description: Barnstock Orange is a premium handmade brick featuring a vibrant mix of orange and rich red tones, creating a warm and distinctive appearance. A blend of red and orange bricks works together to produce natural colour variation, giving each build depth and a refined, high-quality finish.

name: Thames Dean Stock
description: Thames Dean Stock is a traditional yellow stock-style handmade brick developed specifically for the southern market. Featuring soft yellow and buff tones with natural weathering, it closely replicates the appearance of classic London stock brickwork.

name: Renovation Multi
description: Renovation Multi is a high-quality pressed brick designed for projects where consistency, accuracy and ease of use are essential. Featuring a balanced blend of red tones with subtle variation, it delivers a clean, reliable finish with just enough character to complement existing brickwork.

name: Cottage Blend
description: Cottage Blend is a premium handmade brick featuring a distinctive mix of orange, red and dark accent tones, creating a rich and characterful appearance. The combination of colours, along with its textured handmade finish, gives each brick a unique look that adds depth and individuality to any build.

name: Tumbled Cheshire
description: Tumbled Cheshire is a premium handmade brick that has been carefully aged to replicate the look and character of genuine reclaimed materials. Its softened edges and subtle tonal variation create an authentic, time-worn appearance, delivering a finish that feels established and full of depth.

name: Rustic Farmhouse
description: Rustic Farmhouse is a premium handmade brick defined by its heavy texture and a rich blend of earthy reds, browns, buffs and weathered tones. The depth of colour and pronounced surface detail give each brick a distinctive, rugged character, creating a finish that feels authentic and full of presence.

name: Ashgrove Orange
description: Ashgrove Orange is a carefully balanced brick featuring warm orange tones with subtle natural variation throughout. The result is a soft, authentic appearance that feels natural and well-proportioned, rather than flat or uniform. Its tonal blend gives the brick a calm, understated character while still adding depth and interest to finished brickwork.

name: Weathered Yellow
Ashbourne Genuine Reclaimed
description: Ashbourne Reclaimed bricks are genuine reclaimed materials sourced from original buildings and carefully selected for reuse. Each brick carries its own natural weathering, surface marks, and tonal variation, reflecting its previous life and giving every batch a truly authentic appearance.

name: Alford Genuine Reclaimed
description: Alford Reclaimed is a genuine reclaimed brick sourced from original buildings and selected for its natural aged appearance. Each brick shows signs of weathering, surface variation, and historical use, giving the material an authentic character that cannot be reproduced in new production bricks.
